provenance: Original same-author source-preparation concern transcribed from collaboration message; no capability probe or execution occurred. Native visibility assertion is for actual Astra to verify/resolve, not assumed acceptance.
original_author_message: 一个 source-only 能力边界先说明：stdlib signal.getsignal(SIGUSR2) 可拒绝已登记的 Python custom handler，但 faulthandler.register 的既有 native 注册没有公开查询 API。计划要 native SIGUSR2 原 ownership 检查/restore；若要求证明不存在任意先存 native sigaction，这不能由纯 stdlib public API 单独证明。拟记录 getSignal 可见原 handler、当前 hook 冲突、native-preexisting-registration 未可观察，并只 unregister 本插件成功注册；请确认这属于本合同的 visibility limit，还是需要实际 Astra 澄清。尚未安装/执行 observer。

affected_contract.lifecycle: Require exact command/node/output gate. At collection completion require exactly the literal one UTC-memory item. Never invoke --collect-only separately. Before behavior, reject existing non-null sys/threading profile hooks or existing SIGUSR2 custom owner instead of overriding unrelated observers. Record observed coverage, including existing threads not covered by threading.setprofile.
affected_contract.stack_method: At pytest session start register stdlib faulthandler SIGUSR2, all_threads=True, chain=False, writing to exclusive stacks.raw; record native ready receipt <=4KiB with PID, command and plugin pin. No SIGALRM use and no new Python sampler thread. Parent only signals its verified child PID after readiness. Do not use ptrace, gdb, native instrumentation, /proc/mem or external commands.
affected_contract.stack_schedule: 19 fixed request opportunities at child-start +30,60,...,570s; each only once, no catch-up burst/retry. Parent append request sequence, requested/actual monotonic_ns, PID, expected source and pre-signal stack-file size before os.kill(SIGUSR2). Read only this explicit ready JSON <=4KiB (nofollow stable path) while child lives; otherwise metadata-only live artifact walks. No ready receipt by a sample -> record missing, no signal. Subsequent sampled file sizes define raw offset bounds only; request != completed stack sample. Parser reports raw partials and uncertain grouping, never manufactures ack/timestamp.

ROOT_disposition: Do not silently downgrade ownership requirement or add ctypes/sigaction. Pause affected native signal ownership/registration lifecycle source until actual Astra decision; unaffected profiling and parent capture preparation may continue.
